source_name: Македонска берза (Macedonian Stock Exchange) — issuer pages and news archive
why_relevant: Per-issuer hubs link out to historical disclosure documents and carry a dated news archive; the authoritative index of which MK banks are listed and therefore have enforceable historical disclosure trails.

source_name: Централен регистар на РСМ (Central Registry) — годишни сметки / annual accounts repository
why_relevant: Statutory repository of filed annual accounts for every legal entity, including non-listed banks, savings houses, payment institutions and fintechs that publish nothing on their own sites. The only systematic historical financials layer for the unlisted part of the MK payments sector.

source_name: „Отворени финансии" — Ministry of Finance open budget/transactions portal
why_relevant: Executed public-sector transactions by institution — reveals which banks and payment providers hold state accounts and receive state payment-processing spend, an indirect but continuous signal on vendor relationships that no bank discloses.

source_name: Министерство за финансии — Публикации (MoF publications archive)
why_relevant: Multi-year PDF archive of fiscal and financial-system publications, including financial-sector development material; historical issues persist here after being dropped from topical pages.

source_name: Државен завод за статистика — МакСтат database (State Statistical Office)
why_relevant: MAKStat is the queryable long-run statistical database; alongside NBRM statistics it is the archival backbone for reconstructing financial/payments time series and for anchoring bank disclosures to macro context.

source_name: RePEc / IDEAS — National Bank of RNM working paper series
why_relevant: Indexed, permanently archived NBRM research output (e.g. panel estimation of foreign-bank presence effects). RePEc retains papers withdrawn from the bank's own site and gives stable handles plus author-level snowballing into further MK banking research.

source_name: RePEc / IDEAS — Finance Think (Economic Research & Policy Institute, Skopje)
why_relevant: Leading independent MK economic think-tank; its indexed policy studies and surveys cover household finance, credit and financial inclusion — reconstructing demand-side payments/banking data that no institution publishes as a series.

source_name: Економски институт – УКИМ, journal „Economic Development / Економски развој" (open PDF archive, CEEOL-indexed)
why_relevant: Long-running bilingual academic journal with full back issues published as free PDFs on the institute site and mirrored in CEEOL/EBSCO; a durable academic archive of MK banking-sector efficiency, credit and payments studies.

source_name: Економски факултет – Скопје (UKIM) — doctoral dissertations / theses PDF archive
why_relevant: MK doctoral theses on banking and payments contain reconstructed multi-year datasets and interview evidence not available anywhere else; the faculty publishes full-text PDFs under /wp-content/uploads/.

source_name: Службен весник на РСМ — Official Gazette PDF issue archive
why_relevant: Authoritative archive of every banking/payments law, NBRM decision and licence/authorisation notice, with consolidated texts. It is the historical record for regulatory events that banks' own press releases summarise and then delete; also carries a free-access section.

source_name: Стопанска банка АД Скопје — /content/Pdf and /media PDF document store
why_relevant: Representative example of the MK bank pattern: audited statements and shareholder-meeting packs live at stable deep file paths that outlive the navigation linking to them, so the file store is harvestable even after IR pages are rebuilt.

source_name: НЛБ Банка АД Скопје — Годишни финансиски извештаи archive
why_relevant: Multi-year annual financial report listing for one of the largest MK banks; a per-issuer archival page whose older entries are periodically pruned, making it a priority Wayback-snapshot target.

source_name: Алта Банка (ex-Стопанска банка Битола) — Собрание document packs
why_relevant: Shareholder-meeting document packs numbered by session ('Sobranie 54') expose a sequential, guessable archive of financial statements and governance documents across many years — including for a bank that has been rebranded, where the old name is the retrieval key.

source_name: ResearchGate — MK banking-sector studies (e.g. 'Efficiency of the Macedonian banking sector')
why_relevant: Author-deposited copies of MK banking papers that are otherwise behind conference proceedings or vanished journal sites; useful for recovering datasets and citation trails into further MK-authored work.

source_name: CEEOL — Central and Eastern European Online Library (MK economics/banking journals)
why_relevant: Aggregates and permanently archives MK-language economics journals (including „Економски развој"), giving a searchable index of regional banking/payments scholarship whose original publishers are unstable.

source_name: uslugi.gov.mk — national services catalogue entry for Central Registry
why_relevant: Enumerates which registry/document services exist, their access route and fee status — the cheapest way to map what historical filings are legally obtainable before spending on retrieval.

source_name: Комерцијална банка АД Скопје — Односи со инвеститори / за акционери
why_relevant: Largest domestically-controlled MK bank and an MSE-listed issuer (KMB). Its own IR area carries the годишен извештај, ревидирани финансиски извештаи, quarterly 'Извештај и податоци за Банката', shareholder-assembly materials and dividend decisions, normally in Macedonian first.

source_name: Стопанска банка АД — Скопје — 'За акционерите'
why_relevant: NBG-controlled systemic bank listed in the MSE mandatory-listing sub-segment. The 'За акционерите' page is unusually rich: assembly minutes (записник од седница на собрание на акционери), Q&A and voting-results reports, ISIN and share counts for ordinary and priority shares, a multi-year dividend-per-share table, dividend payment forms, plus audited separate and consolidated statements. It also names a dedicated IR officer and mailbox.

source_name: НЛБ Банка АД Скопје — 'За акционерите' / Информации за акционерите
why_relevant: NLB Skopje is MSE-listed (NLB / TEL symbol page on mse.mk) and a consistent dividend payer; its shareholder section publishes assembly convocations at least 21 days ahead, proposed decisions, voting/attendance rules and dividend calendars — the earliest first-party signal of capital-return policy in the MK market.

source_name: НЛБ Банка АД Скопје — Годишни и финансиски извештаи (legacy ASPX report archive)
why_relevant: Back-catalogue of NLB Skopje annual and audited financial reports on the older Cyrillic-path ASPX site; valuable for multi-year time series that the redesigned site may not surface.

source_name: НЛБ Банка АД Скопје — Соопштенија за јавност (corporate press releases)
why_relevant: First-party press-release stream where material items (e.g. 'Информација за исплата на дивиденда', 25.06.2025 start of payout, 2.596 MKD gross per share) are announced. Faster and more granular than the annual report for event-level intelligence.

source_name: Халкбанк АД Скопје — Годишни извештаи / Извештаи
why_relevant: Halkbank MK publishes both consolidated and individual annual reports and audited statements plus the quarterly 'Извештај и податоци за Халкбанк' series (e.g. 30.06 cut-offs) back to roughly 2016 — a clean quarterly time series for a fast-growing Turkish-owned entrant.

source_name: ТТК Банка АД Скопје — Извештај и податоци за Банката / За Банката документи
why_relevant: MSE-listed small/mid bank (symbol TTK). Its site hosts the periodic 'Извештај и податоци за Банката' disclosure PDFs (e.g. as at 31.12.2024) and the corporate-governance code — useful both for financials and for governance/ownership signals in a consolidating market.

source_name: Шпаркасе Банка Македонија АД Скопје — Финансиски извештаи
why_relevant: Steiermärkische Sparkasse subsidiary; the page is explicitly the archive of 'годишни финансиски извештаи, ревидирани единечни и ревидирани консолидирани финансиски извештаи'. Relevant to Austrian-group strategy in MK and to the 2021 Ohridska banka merger legacy.

source_name: УНИБанка АД Скопје — Редовно годишно собрание / Годишен извештај
why_relevant: UNIBanka posts the full agenda pack of the redovno godishno sobranie as numbered 'Точка N' PDFs (annual report, corporate-governance code v19 dated 31.01.2025, etc.). Numbered-agenda publication is unusually granular and lets you reconstruct board proposals, not just outcomes.

source_name: Централна кооперативна банка АД Скопје — Собрание / Извештаи и податоци
why_relevant: Bulgarian-group-owned MK bank, MSE-listed issuer. Site hosts assembly-year folders with 'Извештаи и податоци на Централна кооперативна банка АД Скопје со состојба на …' disclosure PDFs — the standard NBRM-format prudential disclosure set for a smaller bank.

source_name: ПроКредит Банка АД Скопје — Годишен извештај
why_relevant: ProCredit MK publishes standalone Macedonian annual reports (годишен извештај) plus IFRS/MAS statement packs under /content/. As a German-group SME-focused bank its report is the cleanest read on business-banking and digital-channel strategy in MK.
